name: smwgraphics-pok-mon-skarmory-and-voltorb
title: Pokémon - Skarmory and Voltorb
description:
This is a reskin of the custom sprite Albatoss + Albatoss Bomber by mikeyk. I also made a Voltorb reskin for the Torpedo that Albatoss drops.

Voltorb is also available as a bob-omb enemy reskin as well!

I will upload other pokemon reskins that I made for my Hack The Magic Cooking Pot, but I don't know if I will make any new ones. Maybe a bit later.

Anorakun's note: includes a torpedo.cfg that changes the palette of the torpedo sprite to palette row C.
